boundaries: Local requester opinions are not host verification.
Byte totals cover mail and whiteboard, with host controls listed separately; model context is measured in usage tokens.
Accuracy requires both exact phase proofs; protocol settlement is separate.
Observed token threshold can be exceeded by already admitted concurrent calls.
Single-seed bounded runs, including failures, do not establish efficacy or causal topology gains.

budget.tokenLimitKind: observed-total-token admission threshold, not a hard token ceiling
